import sys
import re
from collections import Counter

def main():
    text = sys.stdin.read().lower()
    words = re.findall(r'[a-z]+', text)
    counts = Counter(words)
    top10 = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[:10]
    for word, count in top10:
        print(f"{word} {count}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
